environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB SG to instance on 8080. The /api/users/detail endpoint is accessible from the internet through the ALB. No additional request filtering or input validation middleware is deployed.
